# Air Injector An air injector is a special vent that forcibly pumps gases into the surrounding atmosphere.
It is mainly used to pump gases into high-pressure rooms, such as the station's [textlink="gas storage" link="GasMiningAndStorage"] or a combustion chamber.
An air injector does not require [textlink="power" link="Power"] to operate.
The air injector will pump gases into the surrounding atmosphere until its pressure reaches [color=orange][protodata="GasOutletInjector" comp="GasOutletInjector" member="MaxPressure"/] kPa[/color].
The air injector's speed is proportional to the amount of gas inside it.
